title: Add responsive crayon garden illustrations
purpose: Replace the home hero artwork with a cheerful crayon garden that uses a compact composition on mobile and a longer row of potted plants on desktop.
changes: Created a compact mobile illustration with five potted plants and a plain watering can in a wax-crayon texture.
Created a separate panoramic desktop illustration with a longer row of varied potted plants.
Switched the home hero between the two assets at the desktop breakpoint and tuned their scale and opacity for each layout.

tests.name: npm.cmd run build
tests.details: Vite build completed; the existing large-chunk warning remains.

tests.name: Responsive visual check
tests.details: Verified the compact mobile composition at 390x844 and the panoramic desktop composition in the local app.

next_actions: Publish the verified build to GitHub Pages.
